data.name: Ayaanah
data.gender_notes: Ayaanah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic word 'ayyun, which means guide, helper or one who leads to the truth. The name Ayaanah carries the meaning “Guide, Helper” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ayaanah usually hope their child will grow to embody guide, helper and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Guiding light in the path of righteousness.
data.etymology: Ayaanah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Guide, Helper.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ayaanah total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: عيانة
in_arabic.meaning: المرأة الواضحة الطريقة أو العيانية في تعبيرها
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم عيانة مشتق من العيان، وهو مصدر للفعل عاين، يعني الشخص الذي يرى أو يلاحظ بوضوح. في سياق الأسماء الإسلامية، يُعتبر اسم عيانة تعبيرًا عن الوضوح والصراحة في التعبير أو الطريقة. وقد وردت مشتقات هذا الاسم في القرآن الكريم، مما يعطيه أهمية دينية وروحانية.

in_urdu.name: عیاانہ
in_urdu.meaning: واضح طریقے والی یا صاف صاف بیان کرنے والی
in_urdu.long_meaning: عیاانہ نام عربی زبان کے 'عيان' سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کے معنی ہیں واضح یا صاف دیکھنا۔ اس نام کا مطلب ہے وہ شخص جو واضح طریقے سے دیکھتا ہے یا صاف صاف بات کرتا ہے۔ اسلامی تقویم میں، یہ نام صفائی اور واضحیت کی علامت ہے، خاص طور پر بات چیت یا انداز میں۔

in_hindi.name: आयाना
in_hindi.meaning: स्पष्ट तरीके वाली या साफ़ तौर पर बोलने वाली
in_hindi.long_meaning: आयाना नाम की उत्पत्ति अरबी भाषा से हुई है, जिसका अर्थ है स्पष्ट या साफ़ देखना। यह नाम उस व्यक्ति को दर्शाता है जो स्पष्ट तरीके से देखता है या साफ़ तौर पर बात करता है। इस्लामी परंपरा में, आयाना नाम स्पष्टता और सटीकता का प्रतीक है, विशेष रूप से अभिव्यक्ति या आचरण में।

in_pashto.name: عيانة
in_pashto.meaning: روښانه لاره لرونکې یا څرګنده څرګندونکې
in_pashto.long_meaning: عيانة نوم د عربی ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې معنی یې روښانه یا څرګنده لیدل دي. دا نوم د هغه چا لپاره کارول کیږي چې روښانه لاره ویني یا څرګنده خبرې کوي. په اسلامي دود کې، دا نوم د روښانۍ او څرګندتیا څرګندونه کوي، په ځانګړي ډول په خبرو اترو یا چلند کې.

in_english.name: Ayaanah
in_english.long_meaning: The name Ayaanah is derived from the Arabic root 'ayn-y-n', which means 'to see clearly' or 'to be evident'. In Islamic tradition, Ayaanah signifies clarity and straightforwardness in expression or demeanor. This name is associated with qualities of transparency, honesty, and directness. Although not directly mentioned in the Quran, the root 'ayn-y-n' has related terms that imply clear vision or understanding, reflecting the name's spiritual significance and positive connotations.

data.cultural_impact: The name Ayaanah holds a significant place in Arabic and Islamic cultures as it is derived from the rich tradition of guidance and support. It evokes images of a compassionate, wise and caring leader who can help individuals navigate through the complexities of life. In various Islamic communities, the name Ayaanah is often given to girls to symbolize the belief that they will become pillars of strength and support for their families and communities.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Ayaanah conveys the deeply rooted Islamic belief in the existence of a divine guide and helper. The name represents a reminder that we are never alone in our spiritual journey and that Allah (God) is always there to provide us with guidance, strength and support. Ultimately, the name Ayaanah encourages individuals to seek divine guidance and strives to be a source of spiritual support and nourishment not only for themselves but for those around them.
